propositions: det_floor.py at 793 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap by only 7 lines and must be reduced to meet module-size contract.

The four never-blocking DET checks (p2_resolution, p3_package_existence, p6_ac_quality, p7_destructive) form a closed call graph with zero edges to the retained blocking checks and are candidates for extraction.

Moving the advisory checks to a new det_advisory.py module requires mirroring module-level imports (det_clarity, det_lint helpers) that p6_ac_quality references as bare names, and adding lazy in-body imports of DetResult to avoid runtime cycles.

Retained symbols DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, est_tokens, _clarity_score, _count_ac_items and _description_limit are monkeypatched or imported by name in tests and must stay in det_floor to preserve existing test patches.
The split produces det_floor.py ~566 LOC and det_advisory.py ~303 LOC, both within the 200-500 target band, with det_floor re-exporting moved checks to preserve backward-compatible import paths.
